title: Equivalent
summary: Stieglitz's cloud photographs re-made as the browser's spec-defined feTurbulence noise, so the same seed shows every viewer the identical sky forever.
mechanism: SVG feTurbulence filter primitive: a specification-defined pseudo-random generator renders fractal-noise clouds live from one integer seed, deterministic and identical across conforming browsers; JS only mutates the seed attribute.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
y-a-v-a, Arranged According to the Laws of Chance (2026)
